194:t_3:132.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(But that answer will soon be unnecessary. If we take the Imperial Capital, the fighting will end... No... we'll end it ourselves, with our own hands...)

194:t_10:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yo...! Ho...! Ha...! Ta...! Yaa! Hyah! Take that!」

194:t_10:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「As you can see! Effort + guts = special training!」

194:t_10:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「This is kick practice! To create a new move that surpasses $$ノリコ$$'s Lightning Reversal Kick!」

194:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your excitement when $$ノリコ$$ pulled off that move was really something, wasn't it.」

194:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thanks to that, $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z were produced. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

194:t_10:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So androids can produce $$Ｚチップ$$ too...!」

194:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「They are a product of the stirring of the heart, after all. For you, with your effort and guts, it's only natural.」

194:t_10:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hearing that has my fighting spirit welling up again! I'll absolutely create a new finishing move and make $$ノリコ$$ and Big Sis say 'Gyafun'!」

194:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, please make use of the training menu I've devised.」

194:t_10:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Let's see... Lightning Manji Kick, Lightning Corkscrew Kick, Lightning Pillar-of-Flame Kick, Lightning Super-Electron Drill Kick...!」

194:t_10:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Amazing! If I can master all of these, $$ノノ$$ can get close to $$ノノリリ$$!」

194:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Delightful, this purity... For my part, she is well worth teasing.)

194:t_10:17.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then let's start training right away! Lightning Manji Kick!」

194:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The operation was a great success, $$オズマ$$.」

194:t_10:25.en:
$$オズマ$$
「This is all thanks to you. You were a big help this time, $$ＡＧ$$.」

194:t_10:26.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Because you tracked down where $$バサラ$$ and the others were, I was able to make contact with them.」

194:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm glad to have been of use. This too is the power of the $$Ｚクリスタル$$.」

194:t_10:28.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That thing has that kind of power...?」

194:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ is what you get when you further refine the $$Ｚチップ$$ born from human emotions, raise their purity, and crystallize them.」

194:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally, it responds to human feelings... in a word, the power of life.」

194:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If $$バサラ$$ sings anywhere, the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ picks up the vibrations. After all, his songs are something special.」

194:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By following that, we can even pinpoint his whereabouts.」

194:t_10:33.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I see... So even that thing understands the heat of $$バサラ$$'s songs.」

194:t_10:35.en:
$$バサラ$$
「If my songs can shake its heart, I don't care what it is.」

194:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, $$バサラ$$! In that case, please let me hear your shout too!」

194:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then...! Another day of giving it my all... Business, business!」

194:t_10:40.en:
$$オズマ$$
(Sing, $$バサラ$$... With your song, give $$ランカ$$'s heart courage...)

195:t_000:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Give me a status report.」

195:t_000:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The release of the detention facility was a success! $$エコーズ$$ members are guiding the people who escaped!」

195:t_000:2.en:
$$ラム$$
「The assault team and the fake $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ will be back shortly!」

195:t_000:3.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Still, what a surprise. To think the real $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ would show up.」

195:t_000:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Apparently Major $$オズマ$$ made contact with them on his own, as a trump card.」

195:t_000:5.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Maybe the wish to save $$ランカ$$, sweetie, and the love for $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ worked a miracle.」

195:t_000:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「First, we evacuate the people who were being held. After that, we take the $$ターミナル・ベース$$!」

195:t_000:7.en:
$$ボビー$$
(Hurry it up, $$アルト$$, sweetie.)

195:t_002:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Interception force, crush $c! Transports, vacate this area just in case!」

195:t_002:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain! It seems the abducted citizens are being held aboard that ship!」

195:t_002:2.en:
$$ラム$$
「Ensign $$アルト$$, $$シェリル・ノーム$$, and $$ランカ・リー$$ have been taken aboard!」

195:t_002:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Launch all units. The real fight starts here...!」

195:t_003:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「She, who can call $$ディスヌフ$$ to her side, can't have been taken down.」

195:t_003:2.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$ノノ$$ aside, $$ラルク$$ is an ace of $$トップレス$$, you know.」

195:t_003:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units! Citizens are still being held aboard that transport!」

195:t_003:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「If they get past that line, we can't pursue them any further!」

195:t_004:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Let's hit the transport's engine section and stop it before it escapes!」

195:t_004:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Don't shoot it down, even by mistake! Don't forget there are citizens on board!」

195:t_004:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Roger! I'll go easy on the wrecking!」

195:t_004:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$c, damn you! I'll crush you here and clear my name of all the disgrace so far!」

195:t_004:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$... Do you know the expression 'piling shame upon shame'?」

195:t_004:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Our objective lies far beyond this! Once the citizens are freed, a base like this won't take us long to crush!」

195:t_004:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You...! What do you take my castle for!」

195:t_004:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Castle, my foot! After kidnapping innocent people!」

195:t_004:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll hit you with $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s anger on their behalf!」

195:t_004:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Silence! Earthlings who do nothing but get exploited are no better than livestock! Such wretches getting angry, don't make me laugh!」

195:t_004:11.en:
$$ギルター$$
「This is war! As if the losers have any right to live!」

195:t_005:2.en:
$$クラン$$
「You saved us back there, $$バサラ$$!」

195:t_005:3.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Captain $$ガムリン$$, good work babysitting $$バサラ$$ too.」

195:t_005:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I'm used to it. This sort of thing.」

195:t_005:5.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Even so, you're being way too reckless, $$バサラ$$! Holding a live show right in the middle of the enemy!」

195:t_005:6.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Well, you could say it's the usual, and it is.」

195:t_005:8.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Just so you know, the live show isn't over yet!」

195:t_005:9.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Sing your heart out, $$バサラ$$! I'll cover you!」

195:t_005:10.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-what is he!? Does he intend to sing on the battlefield!」

195:t_005:11.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ギルター$$! You get a good taste of $$バサラ$$'s songs too!」
